verification.details: Independent visual review cleared real desktop and390px mobile captures. lessons: Effect dependencies must use signal accessors; sampled values left the canvas unchanged.
Generate concrete deployment aliases from the project dataset, and test every detail route.
Use an explicit static404 artifact for production; Vite preview uses a different SPA fallback.
When an effect must follow a signal over time, pass the accessor, not a sampled value.
Deployment success and design quality are different claims. The public journal should name both.
For public starter evidence, process exit is part of the proof, not bookkeeping after the proof.
limitations: Canvas art is deterministic browser drawing, not live AI inference.
The archive is client rendered; research detail content is not request-time SSR article HTML.
